ai-at-work.title: Cloudflare launches Adaptive Intelligence to rewrite bot rules on the fly
ai-at-work.excerpt: Cloudflare Inc. today launched Adaptive Intelligence, a detection engine inside Cloudflare Bot Management that writes and discards its own blocking rules while an attack is underway. The engine trains
ai-at-work.dwp_take: Cloudflare built a self-updating bot detection system that rewrites its own blocking rules in real time based on live traffic patterns across their massive network. For digital workplace pros managing security, this matters because bots are evolving faster than humans can write rules, so having AI that adapts on the fly beats playing eternal whack-a-mole. Honestly, it's refreshing when a vendor actually solves a problem instead of just adding another dashboard.
